result.summary: Found 2 issues: duplicate content in the 'Fastest near you' section and a missing rating indicator for a promoted item.

issues.description: Two identical 'Green Bowl Poke' cards with the same image, delivery time, and price appear back-to-back in the 'Fastest near you' carousel, suggesting a data duplication bug rather than two distinct restaurants.
issues.suggestion: Verify the data source and ensure each restaurant listing is unique; remove or replace the duplicate entry.

issues.description: The pizza promo card at the bottom is abruptly cut off by the bottom navigation bar with no visible title or details, unlike other cards in the list which show more content before being clipped.
issues.suggestion: Ensure consistent spacing/padding so at least the title text of the next card is visible above the nav bar, or add a fade/scroll indicator.
